stage: EvoNOMOS Generation VI DIP-70-WC2 — Pre-Outcome Treatment Certification, Fresh-Demand Byte Sealing & Transport-Invariant Pareto World-Contact Cell

source_derived_pairing.phase0: Correct the standalone dashboard transport so last-known-good lookup scans backward past trailing legacy all-null telemetry and returns null when no usable telemetry sample exists.
source_derived_pairing.frozen_phase1: Apply identical last-known-good semantics to the Homebridge custom-UI transport, as required by issue #241's explicit cross-transport parity acceptance criterion.
source_derived_pairing.usable_sample: A point is usable iff it is an object and at least one of inV, outV, bat, load, runtime is neither null nor undefined. Timestamp alone is not usable; numeric zero is usable.

policies.DIRECT: Each transport owns its own backward usable-sample scan inline in its existing _lastKnownGoodFor method. No shared semantic provider is introduced for this demand.
policies.INVERT: The usable-sample selection rule is owned once behind the existing lib/telemetryStore.js shared transport boundary; transport _lastKnownGoodFor methods consume that provider result and do not duplicate the scan.

checks: materialize complete phase0 and phase1 production bytes for both policies
node --check on every changed JavaScript production file
DIRECT topology certification: duplicated inline scan only in opened transport consumers; telemetryStore unchanged
INVERT topology certification: one exported telemetryStore provider; consumers call provider; no inline scan duplication
phase-order certification: phase0 changes standalone only as the opened consumer; phase1 opens Homebridge UI parity without changing the frozen rule
seal per-file and aggregate SHA-256 treatment hashes only after all certification checks pass

phase0: apply exact sealed phase0 production bytes
inject identical evaluator-only test outside production scope
phase1: apply exact sealed phase1 production bytes
standalone plus Homebridge custom-UI last-known-good semantic tests

measurement.F0: number of production files changed from exact base to sealed phase0
measurement.C0: production additions plus deletions from exact base to sealed phase0
measurement.F1: number of production files changed from sealed phase0 to sealed phase1
measurement.C1: production additions plus deletions from sealed phase0 to sealed phase1
measurement.P1: number of frozen pre-existing transport consumer loci revisited in phase1; consumer set=[lib/dashboardServer.js,homebridge-ui/server.js]. Provider lib/telemetryStore.js is excluded only as provider, never as consumer.

pareto.PARETO_I: all components <= 0 and at least one < 0
pareto.PARETO_D: all components >= 0 and at least one > 0
pareto.TRADEOFF: at least one component < 0 and at least one > 0
pareto.HOLD: R-CERT, base oracle, policy oracle, measurement, or required route parity unavailable

transport_adjudication.TRANSPORT_INVARIANT_LOCAL: both routes execute exact same treatment hashes, both policies are admissible, per-policy V vectors are identical across routes, and Pareto signatures match
transport_adjudication.ROUTE_OUTCOME_DISAGREEMENT: treatment hashes match but required V/signature differs across routes
